Attached is a short architecture overview (twopointfive-arch-overview.pdf) and our current deployment matrix. High level: we run a hybrid deployment where inference is split across an on-prem inference cluster (customer-managed) and a cloud aggregator that does enrichment + routing. Our primary ask is a validated reference for a private/VPC deployment and a guidance runbook for fallback to an open-hosted model in case of capacity constraints.

- Any recommended quantization or model-variant we should aim for to minimize latency for 2–4k context use-cases?

James Park (cc’d) is our infra lead and will join the testing sessions.

Thanks — reviewed the TP5 doc. Draft notes below and attached a first-pass checklist (partner-validation-checklist.csv).

High-level recommendations:
- Network: recommend customer VPC peering for lowest latency when TP5 wants direct connectivity. Provide an alternate partner-relay option if customers can't peer (relay uses TLS + mTLS, requires static egress IPs).
- Authentication: support for token-based mTLS or API-key via partner relay; for private deployments we'll request a short-lived cert (rotation every 30 days).
- KV cache: for Llama-style models we observe stable warmup up to ~1.5k tokens for cold starts; beyond that the warmup timeframe increases non-linearly. Plan tests at 512 / 1k / 2k prefixes.
- Quantization: recommend starting with 4-bit QAT where possible; for latency-sensitive workloads we currently see best latency/quality trade-off with a 4-bit optimized variant (we'll note exact model names in the ref doc).

Test matrix (summary):
- Connectivity: VPC peering, partner-relay (mTLS), and NAT fallback.
- Functional: inference parity checks vs hosted baseline for 10 representative prompts.
- Load: 50 RPS sustained for 10 minutes and a 200 RPS spike to validate autoscaling/fallback.
- Stability: 24-hour soak on partner-hosted pathway to inspect memory growth and KV cache hit-rate.

Deliverables we'll produce:
1) redwood-ref-deploy_v1.pdf (reference diagram + network options)
2) partner-validation-checklist.csv (attached)
3) test harness instructions and sample JMeter load profile

Next steps:
- Laura, please propose Wed 17 Mar 09:00–12:00 or Thu 18 Mar 13:00–16:00 PT for the tech call.
- Sergio / Aditya: I'll need access to any TP5 staging endpoints and the SSH bastion details if we validate against their on-prem infra.
